note: Checkpoint E1 baseline: the production engine now has ONE physical, internal, editable source (engine/source/plumline-engine.js) composed build-time into the historical ENGINE_START..END position of solver.html. Direct execution and the Web Worker consume exactly the composed engine bytes. This fixture pins every contract as complete SHA-256 hashes (never abbreviated). It is NOT regenerated during verify; checkCanonicalEngineSource pins the values below. E1 does NOT change engine bytes, public output, or the Worker payload, and does NOT modify engine/engine.js (the legacy Google Sheets add-on mirror, consolidated only in a later phase).

canonical_source.representation: B — the OFFICIAL slice: includes /* ENGINE_START */, excludes /* ENGINE_END */
canonical_source.slice_convention: html.slice(indexOf(ENGINE_START), indexOf(ENGINE_END)); START included, END excluded; same as tests_engine_integrity.js

inner_engine.note: engine bytes with the leading ENGINE_START marker removed (the inner body)

source_markers.note: These markers live in solver.html SOURCE only; they are replaced at build time and NEVER appear in dist. The composer inserts (canonical bytes) + ENGINE_END in their place.
source_markers.historical_position: same inline <script>, before the 9 SOLVER_UI regions (engine composed first, then UI)

solver_source.note: post-E1 source: engine removed, replaced by the SOLVER_ENGINE_SOURCE markers; not directly executable

separator.inserted_by: buildWorker(): new Blob([src + '\n' + glue]) — the single LF between engineSource and glue

worker.token_contract: workerToken increments per solve; responses whose token != current are ignored (stale guard)
worker.fallback_contract: solveMainThread() runs the same inline engine functions when Worker/Blob/URL are unavailable

mirror_inventory.comparison_rule: normalisation may ignore ONLY comments, whitespace and CRLF/LF; it must NOT ignore parameters, literals, operators, calls, returns, conditions, branch structure or defaults
mirror_inventory.production_entry_note: the Worker glue and direct path call detectModel_/solveModel_ in the same lexical scope; the mirror additionally exports the api object for harness.js (Node)

dotProduct_duplicate.scope: each is a NESTED function local to its enclosing function; no top-level hoisting conflict because they live in separate function scopes
dotProduct_duplicate.prevails: neither shadows the other — they are independent locals; each enclosing function sees only its own
dotProduct_duplicate.difference: same computation (sum of coeff*value products); parameter names differ (coeffs/values vs coefficients/values) and one uses a one-line loop, the other a braced loop

newContext_.detail: production forces allowCachedFormulaFallback:false (web grid stores 0 for formulas); the mirror parameterises it via an options argument (Sheets cached value is exact). Different parameter list and default — a real functional divergence, not comments.

readConstraint_.detail: production combines the guard as `if (limitFormula !== null && variables) {...}`; the mirror nests `if (limitFormula !== null) { if (variables) {...} }`. Same allowCachedFormulaFallback:false context is built inside; the branch STRUCTURE differs. A real functional divergence, NOT a comments-only difference.

approved_divergences.contract: exactly these two names may diverge; a third divergent function, a vanished shared name, a mis-classified exclusive, or a divergent constant must fail the checker

provenance.canonical_source: extracted VERBATIM from the approved pre-E1 solver.html engine slice (SHA 5d68ed17...); byte-identical to the D-approved engine
provenance.composed_dist: composed via the ONE official compositor (compose-solver.js), the same used by Vite/composed-html/validate_dist; composed_solver 215539 and dist 218349 match the D-approved public output
provenance.worker: glue reconstructed verbatim from solve-worker-client.js; engineSource == canonical; Blob = engineSource + LF + glue
provenance.mirror_inventory: static AST-style comparison of the two files (comment/whitespace-normalised bodies), pre-E1 state
provenance.do_not_regenerate: This fixture must NOT be rebuilt from the running implementation. checkCanonicalEngineSource pins these hashes; engine-e0-baseline.json pins the same engine SHA and Worker hashes independently; the D goldens pin dist. Update only on a deliberate, reviewed baseline change.
